summary: Baseline CI lane and secrets-hygiene preflight are implemented and all required worktree gates pass, including negative scanner checks. A complete commit object was built with deterministic identity, but worktree Git metadata is read-only, so the commit cannot be written to agent/CLIP-P005 from this sandbox.

tests.name: workflow YAML parse and structure
tests.evidence: safe_load succeeded; triggers, validate steps, and report job match packet

tests.name: secret scanner rejection checks
tests.evidence: tracked .env.local and fake AWS key each produced exit 1

tests.name: commit connectivity/content check
tests.command: git diff-tree -r <base> <pending commit> and git fsck
tests.evidence: five intended paths added; no unintended changes or missing objects

security_rights_budget_impact: Adds fail-closed checks for tracked secret-like paths and common credential/private-key signatures; no credentials introduced and no external side effects.
known_limitations: Pattern scan is heuristic and does not replace periodic secret auditing or provider-side key checks.
ci-results reporting uses the repository GITHUB_TOKEN until an API token exists.
Read-only worktree Git metadata prevents branch-head update from this worktree; pending commit object is ready for orchestrator application.
blockers: git metadata /srv/clipos/clipOS/.git and worktree gitdir are read-only; index writes, ref writes, and HEAD update fail with EROFS
